svg.title: Site map
svg.desc: Visitors reach Role Prep home or a public sub-topic page, go to Setup, and land on Today. From Today they open Topics, setback states, the Practice room, a mock round, the night-before sheet or their profile. The Practice room opens the microphone notice, the own-AI page and the pass offer. A mock round ends in results that feed back into Today.
svg.text: Fourteen screens and states in five areas, all reached from Today once you are set up

g.text: Topics and Setback states both lead on to the Practice room
